name: 1H-LSD
summary: 1H-LSD, also known as 1-hexanoyl-LSD or as SYN-L-027, is an acylated derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD), with a six carbon hexanoyl chain attached to the N1 position.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a prodrug for LSD, and in animal studies produces drug-appropriate responding with a similar potency to short-chain homologues such as ALD-52 and 1P-LSD, in contrast to the 4 and 5 carbon homologues 1B-LSD and 1V-LSD which are several times weaker.

uses.text: 1H-LSD produces similar effects to LSD with a shorter metabolic half-life. There are no documented cases of it being used recreationally.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the lysergamides such as LSD, cause strong changes in perception and mood, and can bring anxiety, panic, confusion, a faster heartbeat and nausea. In some people they can trigger lasting mental health problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的麥角醯胺類藥物（例如LSD）會強烈改變知覺與情緒，也可能帶來焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、心跳加快與噁心。對部分人可能引發長期的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的麦角酰胺类药物（例如LSD）会强烈改变知觉与情绪，也可能带来焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、心跳加快与恶心。对部分人可能引发长期的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its six carbon hexanoyl chain comes from hexanoic acid, whose old name, caproic acid, comes from the Latin word for goat because of its smell.
fact.zh: 它的六碳己醯基來自己酸，己酸的舊名caproic acid源自拉丁文的山羊，因為它的氣味像山羊。
fact.zhHans: 它的六碳己酰基来自己酸，己酸的旧名caproic acid源自拉丁文的山羊，因为它的气味像山羊。
